title: A new look for the Hypergate icon

features.title: The Midnight gate, from Dock to browser tab
features.detail: The launcher, browser tab, and MCP connection now share the same violet-to-cyan gate. The macOS menu-bar icon stays monochrome.

changes.title: Nekko Agent shows its own icon in the agent picker

features.title: Install Antigravity CLI from Hypergate
features.detail: Run Google’s installer from the tool catalog, or approve an agent’s request to install it. Sign in to Google from your terminal afterward.

title: More control over what agents can do

features.title: Set permissions one tool at a time
features.detail: Block individual tools or put an agent in read-only mode so it sees only tools the server marks read-only.

features.title: Invite teammates to your gateway
features.detail: Opt in to team access and give each person a token scoped to the servers and tools they need.

features.title: Flag unusual activity
features.detail: Security Insights surfaces denied calls, sudden spikes, and first-time use of tools that can make changes.

changes.title: Block vault keys in tool arguments and redact them from results

title: The manager gets the Midnight Gate design

features.title: The app and website share a design
features.detail: Both app themes use the site’s type, capsule buttons, and colour accents. The fonts are bundled, so the app looks the same offline.

title: Keep more keys in the vault

features.title: Credential lockdown
features.detail: Turn off direct key retrieval by agents and let approved programs use keys through Hypergate instead.

features.title: Find logins stored outside Hypergate
features.detail: Review credentials that supported tools saved locally, and choose which ones to move into the vault.

changes.title: Offer managed instructions for supported agent harnesses

title: Install a CLI and get signed in

features.title: Continue into account setup after installing a CLI
features.detail: Hypergate opens browser-based sign-in when it can. For setup that needs an interactive terminal, it shows the exact command to run.

title: Find and set up an MCP server by name

features.title: See what a server needs before you add it
features.detail: Look up a server in the official MCP Registry and get a setup checklist, from runtimes and credentials to browser sign-in.

features.title: Agents can request servers
features.detail: Review why a server was requested, how it will run, and which setup steps remain before approving it.

title: Manage command-line tools in the app

features.title: Install, repair, or remove tools with a live log
features.detail: Run supported package-manager commands from the tool’s row and see the output as it arrives.

features.title: Approve or deny an agent’s install request
features.detail: See the tool and why the agent needs it before Hypergate runs the installer.

features.title: Store API keys in your OS keychain
features.detail: Keep keys out of server configuration files, grant access per agent, and see when a key was used.
